plain: The particular choice and arrangement of words

webster.text: Manner of expression; peculiar words used in a sentence; diction.

example.quote: When we say a representative shall be chosen by the people, it seems to imply that he shall be chosen by a majority of them; but states which use the same phraseology in this respect, practice both ways.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XII, Jan. 12, 1788
